snippet.title: Being and Becoming | Coming 2027 | CRTime
snippet.description:
Take control of your fate before it gets rewritten by The Word. Being and Becoming will launch in 2027, try the demo now on Steam!

This atmospheric metroidvania will let you explore a vast, corrupted dreamscape and collect hidden artifacts to improve your combat and exploration skills before you're ready to meet The Word.
The game will also come to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5.

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917990/Being_and_Becoming/
